en: You notice you keep repeating a pattern of relationships that hurts you.
ph_ar: كل مرة ندخل في نفس النوع من العلاقات المؤذية
ph_en: I keep ending up in the same kind of painful relationships

en: You learn to tell your responsibility apart from other people's.
ph_ar: نحمل هموم الناس الكل كأنها مسؤوليتي
ph_en: I carry everyone's problems as if they were my responsibility

en: You reverse a decision after new information comes to light.
ph_ar: رجعت في قراري بعد ما ظهرت معلومات جديدة
ph_en: I changed my decision after learning something new and feel awkward

en: You accept that someone will not like you however hard you try to please them.
ph_ar: مهما عملت ما يحبنيش
ph_en: No matter what I do, she just doesn't like me

en: You admit to yourself that you need rest before you can carry on.
ph_ar: لازمني نرتاح قبل ما نكمل
ph_en: I have to admit I need a break before I can keep going

en: You discover a new interest that changes your earlier plans.
ph_ar: لقيت شغف جديد قلب كل مخططاتي
ph_en: I found a new passion that changes all my plans

en: You learn to celebrate small progress instead of waiting for perfection.
ph_ar: نحاول نفرح بالتقدم الصغير بلا ما نستنى الكمال
ph_en: I'm learning to celebrate small wins instead of waiting to be perfect

en: You face an old fear with a small, careful step.
ph_ar: قررت نواجه خوف قديم بخطوة صغيرة
ph_en: I'm facing an old fear one small step at a time

en: You give up the habit of comparing and set a standard that fits your circumstances.
ph_ar: نحب نبطل نقارن روحي بالناس
ph_en: I want to stop comparing myself to everyone else

en: You look back at a hard experience and notice what you learned from it.
ph_ar: نتأمل في تجربة صعيبة وشنوة علمتني
ph_en: I'm reflecting on what a hard time taught me

en: You see an elderly neighbour carrying heavy bags.
ph_ar: جارتي الكبيرة تهز في حوايج ثقال
ph_en: My elderly neighbour was carrying heavy shopping

en: Someone asks you for directions while you are in a hurry.
ph_ar: واحد سألني على الطريق وأنا مزروب
ph_en: Someone asked me for directions while I was rushing

en: You volunteer and then discover it takes far more time than you expected.
ph_ar: تطوعت والوقت اللي يطلبوه أكثر بياسر مما توقعت
ph_en: I volunteered and it's taking far more time than I expected

en: You organise a relief campaign and struggle to share out the roles.
ph_ar: ننظم حملة خيرية وما عرفتش نوزع الأدوار
ph_en: I'm running a charity drive and can't organise the volunteers

en: You must choose who benefits from resources that are not enough for everyone.
ph_ar: المساعدات ما تكفيش الكل ولازمني نختار
ph_en: There isn't enough aid for everyone and I have to choose who gets it

en: You disagree with another volunteer about the best way to help.
ph_ar: اختلفت مع متطوع آخر على طريقة المساعدة
ph_en: Another volunteer and I disagree on how best to help

en: You receive a donation with conditions that do not suit the initiative's goal.
ph_ar: متبرع حاطط شروط ما تناسبش المبادرة
ph_en: A donor attached conditions that don't fit our project

en: You discover that someone needs to be listened to more than advised.
ph_ar: فهمت أنها تحتاج نسمعها موش ننصحها
ph_en: I realised she needed me to listen, not to give advice

en: Someone you once fell out with helps you.
ph_ar: واحد كنت متخاصم معاه جا عاوني
ph_en: Someone I'd fallen out with came to help me

en: You work with people from different backgrounds on a shared project.
ph_ar: نخدم في مشروع مع ناس من خلفيات مختلفة
ph_en: I'm working on a project with people from very different backgrounds

en: Someone tries to humiliate a person in need while helping them.
ph_ar: واحد يعاون الفقير ويهينو قدام الناس
ph_en: Someone humiliated a poor person while giving them help

en: Someone refuses your help to protect their dignity or independence.
ph_ar: عرضت عليه مساعدة ورفض حفاظًا على كرامتو
ph_en: He turned down my help out of pride

en: You look for a way to support someone without revealing their situation to others.
ph_ar: نحب نعاونها بلا ما الناس يعرفوا ظروفها
ph_en: I want to help her without anyone knowing her situation

en: You stand by a colleague who is being excluded.
ph_ar: زميلي مقصي من الفريق ونحب نقف معاه
ph_en: A colleague is being frozen out and I want to stand up for him

en: You help clean a public place and then see someone littering it again.
ph_ar: نظفنا الحومة ورجعوا وسخوها
ph_en: We cleaned the neighbourhood and people trashed it again

en: You try to resolve a dispute among neighbours over a shared space.
ph_ar: الجيران متخاصمين على الباركينغ المشترك
ph_en: The neighbours are fighting over the shared parking

en: You notice a need in your neighbourhood and start a small initiative.
ph_ar: لاحظت حاجة في الحومة وبديت مبادرة
ph_en: I noticed a need in my neighbourhood and started a small project

en: You make a volunteer effort whose results do not show right away.
ph_ar: نتطوع وما نشوفش نتيجة
ph_en: I volunteer but never see any results

en: You learn to accept that your ability to help has limits.
ph_ar: ما نجمش نعاون الناس الكل وهذا يوجعني
ph_en: It hurts that I can't help everyone

en: You see the effect of a small kindness you did long ago that you thought no one remembered.
ph_ar: واحد تفكرني بمساعدة صغيرة عملتها من سنين
ph_en: Someone remembered a small kindness I did years ago

en: You start university and lose the "top student" title, among talented people, and ask: who am I if I am not the best?
ph_ar: كنت الأول في المعهد وفي الجامعة وليت عادي
ph_en: I was top of my class at school and now I'm just average at university

en: You laugh with friends at someone like you in a way you hide from them, then go home feeling you betrayed part of yourself to stay accepted.
ph_ar: ضحكت مع صحابي على حاجة فيا وحسيت خنت روحي
ph_en: I laughed along with my friends at something I secretly share and felt I betrayed myself

en: You act differently with family, friends and online until you cannot tell which one is really you.
ph_ar: عندي شخصية في الدار وشخصية مع صحابي وشخصية على النت
ph_en: I'm a different person at home, with friends and online, and don't know who I really am

en: People your age seem to "know what they want" while your interests keep changing, and you fear you are lost.
ph_ar: الناس الكل عارفة شنوة تحب وأنا لا
ph_en: Everyone my age seems to know what they want except me

en: You hide your family's financial situation from classmates and invent excuses not to go out.
ph_ar: نخبي على صحابي أنو عائلتي فقيرة
ph_en: I hide from my friends that my family is poor

en: You are praised for being mature and needing no one, so you cannot admit you are scared and need reassurance.
ph_ar: يقولولي إنت قوي وأنا داخلي خايف
ph_en: Everyone thinks I'm strong and don't need anyone, but I'm scared inside

en: Your worth is reduced to your looks, strength or grades, and you fear losing the one thing people praise.
ph_ar: الناس تحبني على شكلي برك
ph_en: People only value me for my looks

en: You are the first in your family to go to university and feel proud and out of place at once.
ph_ar: أول واحد في عائلتي يدخل الجامعة ونحس روحي غريب
ph_en: I'm the first in my family at university and feel like I don't fit in

en: You discover a talent you love but avoid practising it in public because you cannot bear to look like a beginner.
ph_ar: نحب الرسم بس نخاف الناس تشوفني مبتدئ
ph_en: I love drawing but I'm afraid to be seen as a beginner

en: Someone asks your real opinion and you realise you know other people's views better than your own.
ph_ar: سألوني على رايي وما لقيتش راي متاعي
ph_en: Someone asked my real opinion and I realised I don't have one of my own

en: Graduation approaches and you dread it, because being a student gave you a clear path.
ph_ar: قرب التخرج ونخاف من اللي بعدو
ph_en: I'm about to graduate and I'm terrified of what comes after

en: You take an unpaid internship, then see classmates afford it with family support while you work nights.
ph_ar: نخدم بلاش في التربص ونخدم في الليل باش نعيش
ph_en: I'm doing an unpaid internship and working nights to survive

en: You get a job others dream of but wake up every morning weighed down.
ph_ar: عندي خدمة الناس الكل تتمناها وأنا كاره
ph_en: I have a dream job on paper but I dread every morning

en: Repeated job rejections make you read each one as a verdict on your character.
ph_ar: كل رفض في الخدمة نحسو رفض ليا أنا
ph_en: Every job rejection feels like a rejection of who I am

en: A friend gets an opportunity through connections while you keep trying alone.
ph_ar: صاحبي خذا الخدمة بالمعارف وأنا نتعب وحدي
ph_en: My friend got a job through connections while I struggle on my own

en: You used AI tools for most of your graduation project and fear the defence.
ph_ar: عملت مشروع التخرج بالذكاء الاصطناعي وخايف من المناقشة
ph_en: I used AI for most of my final project and I'm scared of the defence

en: You think about leaving your major in your final year.
ph_ar: نفكر نسيّب الاختصاص في آخر عام
ph_en: I'm thinking of dropping my major in my final year

en: You work a temporary job far from your degree and avoid old classmates.
ph_ar: نخدم خدمة بعيدة على قرايتي ونتهرب من زملائي
ph_en: I work a job unrelated to my degree and avoid my old classmates

en: You devote every hour to self-improvement until you feel guilty relaxing with a friend.
ph_ar: نحس بالذنب كي نرتاح أو نقعد مع صحابي
ph_en: I feel guilty whenever I'm not being productive

en: You pass a decisive exam after long pressure but feel no joy, only the tiredness you had postponed.
ph_ar: نجحت في الباك وما فرحتش حسيت بالتعب برك
ph_en: I passed the big exam but I only feel exhausted

en: In a first mutual attraction you give up your interests and friends to be always available.
ph_ar: من وقت ما تعلقت بيه سيّبت صحابي وهواياتي
ph_en: Since I fell for him I've dropped my friends and hobbies

en: Someone comes close when lonely and pulls away when better, leaving you waiting for their attention.
ph_ar: يجيني كي يكون وحدو ويبعد كي يرتاح
ph_en: He only comes to me when he's lonely and disappears when he's fine

en: You want a clear, serious relationship but the other person asks you to wait with no date.
ph_ar: يقولي استنى وما يعطينيش وقت
ph_en: He keeps telling me to wait for marriage with no date

en: A first relationship ends and you feel your whole future ended with it.
ph_ar: أول علاقة كملت وحاسس مستقبلي كامل تهدّ
ph_en: My first relationship ended and I feel my whole future is gone

en: Someone asks you for private photos to prove you trust them.
ph_ar: طلب مني تصاوير خاصة باش نثبتلو ثقتي
ph_en: He's asking me for private photos to prove I trust him

en: You watch someone's online status more than you listen to your own feelings, and one message decides your whole day.
ph_ar: نراقب وقتاش يكون أونلاين ومزاجي مربوط برسايلو
ph_en: My whole mood depends on whether he texts me

en: You are drawn to someone but realise it may be an escape from emptiness more than real knowledge of them.
ph_ar: معجب بيها بس يمكن نهرب من الفراغ
ph_en: I like her but maybe I'm just running from loneliness

en: Someone respectfully declines to be with you and you must accept their choice without hating them or yourself.
ph_ar: رفضتني بأدب وما نعرفش كيفاش نتقبل
ph_en: She politely turned down my proposal and I can't accept it

en: Starting a new relationship, you keep asking the other person to prove they will not repeat a past hurt.
ph_ar: نطلب منو يثبتلي أنو ما يعاودش اللي عملو اللي قبلو
ph_en: I keep making my new partner pay for what my ex did

en: You are in a relationship that does not clearly hurt you but gives no peace, and you wait for a big mistake to justify leaving.
ph_ar: علاقة ما تأذينيش بس ما نرتاحش فيها
ph_en: The relationship isn't bad, but I don't feel at peace in it

en: You want to live near work but your family reads independence as abandoning them.
ph_ar: نحب نسكن قريب الخدمة وأهلي يحسبوني نهرب منهم
ph_en: I want to move out for work but my parents see it as abandoning them

en: You receive your first salary and feel you must hand it all to your family.
ph_ar: أول شهرية لازمني نعطيها للعائلة كاملة
ph_en: I'm expected to give my whole first salary to my family

en: Facing a big decision you fear your father's anger more than the outcome itself.
ph_ar: نخاف من غضب بابا أكثر من القرار نفسو
ph_en: I'm more afraid of my father's anger than of the decision itself

en: As the eldest everyone turns to you, yet no one asks how tired you are.
ph_ar: أنا الكبير والكل يلتجئ ليا وحتى حد ما يسأل عليا
ph_en: As the eldest everyone leans on me and no one asks how I am

en: Your family refuses a job or trip out of fear for you, while you see a real opportunity.
ph_ar: أهلي رافضين نسافر للخدمة خوفًا عليا
ph_en: My parents won't let me take a job abroad because they're scared for me

en: A young woman in the family faces restrictions her brothers do not.
ph_ar: خوتي الذكور يعملوا اللي يحبوا وأنا ممنوعة
ph_en: My brothers can do anything but I'm not allowed

en: A young man is told to bear everything because he is a man, so anger becomes the only feeling he shows.
ph_ar: قالولي الراجل ما يبكيش فوليت نتعصب برك
ph_en: I was taught men don't cry, so anger is all I show

en: One parent asks you to mediate in their dispute with the other.
ph_ar: أمي تحب نوقف معاها ضد بابا
ph_en: My mother wants me to take her side against my father

en: You know your parents gave what they could, yet you carry pain from some of their actions.
ph_ar: نعرف والديا عملوا اللي يقدروا بس جرحوني
ph_en: I know my parents did their best but they still hurt me

en: For the first time you refuse a decision the family made for you and feel intense guilt.
ph_ar: لأول مرة رفضت قرار العائلة ونحس بذنب كبير
ph_en: I refused my family's decision for the first time and feel so guilty

en: You keep counting reactions to a photo and delete it when the likes are fewer than expected.
ph_ar: نفسخ التصويرة كي ما تجيبش لايكات
ph_en: I delete my photos when they don't get enough likes

en: You follow people your age showing off travel, money and success and measure your life against their best moments.
ph_ar: الناس في عمري يسافروا ويربحوا وأنا لا
ph_en: People my age are travelling and making money while I'm stuck

en: You use photo filters until your real face feels less acceptable.
ph_ar: ما نحبش وجهي بلا فلتر
ph_en: I hate how I look without filters

en: You overspend on a phone or clothes so as not to look inferior in your group.
ph_ar: شريت تلفون فوق قدرتي باش ما نكونش أقل من صحابي
ph_en: I bought a phone I couldn't afford to keep up with my friends

en: An embarrassing clip of you spreads at school or university.
ph_ar: فيديو محرج ليا دار في الجامعة الكل
ph_en: An embarrassing video of me went around the whole university

en: You copy the views of an influencer you like, then find a contradiction in their behaviour.
ph_ar: كنت نقلد مؤثر واكتشفت أنو متناقض
ph_en: I followed an influencer's every opinion and then saw him contradict himself

en: Friends push you to try a drug or a dangerous dare and call your refusal cowardice.
ph_ar: صحابي يضغطوا عليا نجرب الحشيش ويقولولي جبان
ph_en: My friends pressure me to try drugs and call me a coward

en: You start exercising for your health and become obsessed with measuring and comparing your body.
ph_ar: وليت مهووس بجسمي ونوزن روحي كل نهار
ph_en: I've become obsessed with checking my body every day

en: Classmates mock anyone who seeks psychological help while you secretly look for it.
ph_ar: زملائي يتمسخروا على اللي يمشي لطبيب نفسي وأنا محتاج
ph_en: My friends mock people who see a therapist, but I need one

en: You switch off your phone and feel anxious about missing something.
ph_ar: كي نسكّر التلفون نحس روحي باش يفوتني شي
ph_en: I get anxious whenever I turn my phone off

en: You have a sincere religious question but fear asking it.
ph_ar: عندي سؤال في الدين ونخاف نسألو
ph_en: I have a genuine question about my faith but I'm scared to ask

en: You move from a familiar environment to a university of many ideas and need to understand your convictions deeply.
ph_ar: في الجامعة سمعت أفكار خلتني نراجع قناعاتي
ph_en: University ideas made me question what I believe

en: You see someone who speaks much about morals acting unjustly.
ph_ar: واحد متدين ويظلم الناس وهذا شككني
ph_en: Seeing a religious person act unjustly shook my faith

en: You relapse in a habit you are trying to quit and feel you do not deserve to start again.
ph_ar: رجعت للعادة وحاسس ما نستاهلش نبدا من جديد
ph_en: I relapsed again and feel I don't deserve another chance

en: You perform your usual worship but feel inner dryness.
ph_ar: نصلي بس ما نحس بشي
ph_en: I pray but I don't feel anything anymore

en: Painful news raises questions about justice and suffering and you want space to think.
ph_ar: علاش ربي يخلي الناس يتعذبوا هكا
ph_en: Why does God let people suffer like this?

en: Your convictions slowly diverge from your group's and you fear losing all your friends at once.
ph_ar: أفكاري تبدلت وخايف نخسر صحابي الكل
ph_en: My views have changed and I'm scared of losing my whole friend group

en: You have a chance to cheat for a grade you need for a scholarship.
ph_ar: عندي فرصة نغش باش نضمن المنحة
ph_en: I could cheat to keep my scholarship

en: You volunteer to help and notice you wait for photos and praise.
ph_ar: نتطوع وننتظر الشكر والتصاور
ph_en: I volunteer but catch myself wanting the praise

en: You wonder whether you must have a great mission young, or whether a decent life and honest relationships are worthy too.
ph_ar: لازم يكون عندي رسالة كبيرة في الحياة؟
ph_en: Do I need some huge purpose in life to matter?

en: You reach an age you once tied to a list of achievements and grieve the imagined version of yourself.
ph_ar: وصلت لعمر كنت نحسب نكون فيه حاجة أخرى
ph_en: I'm thirty and my life looks nothing like I planned

en: You plan to emigrate as the solution to all your pain, then wonder which problems moving will really change.
ph_ar: نحسب الهجرة باش تحل مشاكلي الكل
ph_en: I think emigrating will fix all my problems

en: Your friends marry one after another and society reads your singleness as a delay.
ph_ar: صحابي الكل عرّسوا وأنا لا والناس تسأل
ph_en: All my friends are married and people keep asking when it's my turn

en: You postpone a project or marriage because your income is unstable.
ph_ar: نأجل الزواج خاطر ما عنديش دخل ثابت
ph_en: I keep postponing marriage because my income isn't stable

en: You lose a friend your own age and face the fragility of long-term plans.
ph_ar: مات صاحبي في عمري وحسيت الحياة قصيرة
ph_en: A friend my age died and suddenly life feels so fragile

en: A close friend is in deep distress and asks you to keep everything secret.
ph_ar: صاحبي في حالة صعيبة برشا وطلب مني نسكت
ph_en: My friend is going through something very dark and made me promise not to tell

en: You wake up day after day with no drive to study or meet anyone.
ph_ar: نصبح كل نهار بلا رغبة في شي
ph_en: I wake up every day with no motivation for anything

en: You leave a group that gave you belonging but hurt you, and resist going back just to escape the emptiness.
ph_ar: بعدت على صحاب مؤذيين وتوا نحس بالفراغ
ph_en: I left a toxic friend group and now I feel empty

en: You start again after an academic or career setback and face people's questions.
ph_ar: نبدا من جديد بعد ما طحت والناس تسأل
ph_en: I'm starting over after failing and everyone keeps asking questions

en: You take a small step towards a life you choose, though fear remains and the plan is incomplete.
ph_ar: خذيت خطوة صغيرة رغم الخوف
ph_en: I took a small step towards the life I want even though I'm scared
